## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, mixed signals and major divergence; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: sector returns split (Energy/Utilities/Financials/Healthcare positive vs Tech/Consumer/Industrials weak) and multiple large-cap divergences (several names show 1W ≠ 1M), Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging overall: MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials and select high-multiple names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND; watch INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY as a tactical reversal candidate. Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (MSFT, V, MA, INTC, PLTR, INTU) — treat moves as tactical, not decisive.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but not broad leadership: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND while MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) is in CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation and stock-specific flows dominate.

8. Financials Outlook?
Tepidly constructive: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND while V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) and MA (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +0.57%) show short-term pullbacks (CORRECTION); sector acting as a stabilizer in current mix.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensive bid but headline risk present: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND despite negative headlines, UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND — watch news-driven dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Utilities and Healthcare exposure while reducing exposure to the weakest Consumer Discretionary and lagging Technology names; position size selectively as signals remain mixed. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat recent big-cap rebounds (INTC, INDU names) as tactical opportunities given MAJOR divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +13.73%) and Utilities (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) on momentum and M&A flows. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +2.14%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -5.15%) for continued stock-specific risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA needs follow-through above recent 1W highs to confirm ABOVE TREND extension; AAPL holding short-term support around its 1M base to keep ABOVE TREND intact; INTC must sustain the 1W reversal to validate RECOVERY; MSFT slipping further below weekly pivots would confirm CORRECTION momentum.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+60): UnitedHealth earnings beat; UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirming short-term strength. GOOGL (+50): Court ruling/ad-tech changes; GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND — sentiment bullish but price diverging (distribution risk). CAT (+50): Upgrade; CAT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: -5.02%) RECOVERY — sentiment supporting tactical upside.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (-75): Talc verdict headlines; JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND — bearish news diverging from price (watch for distribution). TSLA (-55): NHTSA probe headline; TSLA (1W: +1.53% | 1M: +10.81%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price holding strength (monitor). WMT (-45): DOJ probe expansion; WMT (1W: +3.93% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY — bearish headlines align with 1M weakness, watch follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large caps (MSFT CORRECTION, INTC RECOVERY, JNJ bearish headlines vs rising price) — monitor news-driven flows.
